summary: Iteration 13 verification — 14/14 backend pytest tests PASS and 100% of targeted frontend UI checks PASS. New auth flow (3-tab login, identifier-lookup → single/multi disambiguation → OTP → picker → password) works end-to-end on the preview URL. Order-tracking backend endpoints (GET /admin/tracking/steps, POST /orders/create seeded 'placed' event, POST /payments/cashfree/verify appends 'confirmed' event, PUT /admin/orders/{id} appends history events + updates courier/tracking fields + creates delivery notifications) all verified. Frontend: /login renders 3 tabs (mobile/email/username); username fast-path skips OTP and lands on /dashboard; mobile-multi (9876500099) flows through OTP → picker (EG000043, EG000044, both showing @username) → password → /dashboard; mobile-single (admin phone 9999999999) SKIPS OTP → password → /admin; email-single (admin@evergroemart.com) skips OTP → password stage; use-diff-account-btn and cancel-otp-btn correctly reset to input stage. /join-now T&C: TermsModal opens, loads terms HTML (2929 chars), 'I Accept' auto-ticks join-terms-checkbox and closes modal, X-close closes without ticking. /orders list renders clickable order cards with status badges. /orders/{id} shows tracking-steps (green progression), tracking-history timeline (3 events), tracking-number-card with courier name + copy-tracking-btn + track-online-btn, items list. Admin /admin/orders: 6 status filter buttons visible (all/placed/confirmed/packed/shipped/out_for_delivery/delivered), edit-tracking-{code} opens tracking-modal with all 6 status-btn-*, courier-name-input, tracking-no-input, tracking-note-input, save-tracking-btn.

ui_bugs.issue: Shipping address renders `order.address.full_name` but /orders/create payload uses `name` (see OrderCreate model). The name field will render blank on the detail page. Not caught in the visible viewport screenshot (below the fold) — verify by scrolling. Recommended fix: use `order.address.name || order.address.full_name`.

action_items: Optional: fix OrderDetail.jsx address field name mismatch (`address.full_name` → `address.name`).

Optional: consider changing /admin/orders/{id} PUT so a status change that MATCHES the current status (no diff, no note) does NOT append a duplicate history event. Current logic already guards this via `should_append` — verified working.
No other changes required — iteration 13 is production-ready from a functional standpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 2411 lines. Split into routers (auth, orders, tracking, admin) — highest technical-debt item.
OrderDetail.jsx address.full_name typo — will produce blank name in the address block; low visibility bug but user-facing.

TrackingModal.save always sends the full form even if only status changed — backend already filters via `allowed` set so it's fine, but keep in mind future field additions must be added to allowed set in server.py:1889.

Login.jsx tab switch resets password state (good) but also resets identifier state? No — identifier stays on cross-tab flips because the initial useEffect deps=[tab] only resets stage/otp/etc. This is deliberate; verified via testing.

/auth/login-with-code has no rate limiting — brute force risk since it accepts user_code + password with no OTP gate. Existing /auth/login has similar exposure so this is a pre-existing pattern, but worth adding a login-attempts rate limit before production launch.

Login flow after OTP verification does NOT require re-verifying OTP if user clicks 'use-different-account' back-and-forth. Once OTP is verified via /auth/otp/verify, the client can freely call /auth/login-with-code with any user_code on that phone. This matches the design intent (OTP verifies phone ownership, password picks the identity) but should be documented.
